lastResponse.text: I’m glad you called. Trouble breathing and shaking can be an emergency. Please call nine one one now or ask someone nearby to call for you right now. If you can talk after that, I can help with a clinic today: Chronic Care Medical Clinic, 945 Washington Way, Suite 141, Longview. Phone is 360… 442… 4165.
